title: Process diagnosis
description: A visit to your business to watch the operation as it happens. You leave with the bottleneck identified, a proposal for what to build first and an estimate.

title: Custom tool
description: The system you are missing, built for your operation: orders, inventory, appointments, quotes, daily closings and reports. It works on the phone at the counter and on the computer in the office.

title: Portal, app and mobile
description: Public site, customer app and iOS/Android applications, with a payment gateway, two-factor authentication, biometrics and identity verification.
